cmd: /opt/zerobrew/bin/btop -c btop.conf -f btop (default config with update_ms=1000, show_disks=false)
notes: btop 1.4.7 for about 2.5 s then q. Process list filtered to btop to avoid exposing other command lines. Truecolor SGR, synchronized output, mouse modes. Scrubbed: username in the User column -> user, LAN IPv4 -> 198.51.100.100 (same byte length).
